verdict.rationale: Shopify Agentic Commerce exposes UCP MCP servers, a CLI, and webhooks that agents use to discover products, build carts, check out, and track orders. A commerce platform could plausibly offer automation management, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows a way to version, review, or roll back user automations. Dated UCP spec releases and API version headers are protocol versioning, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
